root_cause.text: In `adjust_reg_min_max_vals()`, when `src_reg == dst_reg`, the dst_reg is modified in-place before reading src_reg to compute the delta for linked register tracking, causing the delta to be based on the post-operation value instead of the original source.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check to skip delta tracking when `insn->src_reg == insn->dst_reg` and the instruction is BPF_X, preventing the use of the overwritten value. The commit message explicitly states: "the subsequent is_reg_const(src_reg)/reg_const_value(src_reg) reads the post-{add,sub} value instead of the original source."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix verifier to skip constant propagation on self-modifying ALU instructions where src_reg == dst_reg.
intent_record.what: Added a condition to exclude ALU operations where the source register is the same as the destination register (BPF_X with src_reg == dst_reg) from entering the code block that uses the constant value of the source register.
intent_record.how: Prevents the verifier from incorrectly assuming the source register holds a constant when it is actually the same as the destination register being modified, thus avoiding potential miscomputations of offsets or unsound optimizations.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement modifies dst_reg in-place via adjust_scalar_min_max_vals, and when src_reg == dst_reg, subsequent reading of src_reg for delta computation uses the modified value, leading to incorrect linked register tracking.
